name: hugo-site
title: Hugo site
blurb: Content site on Hugo: hand-written layouts, a shortcode, fingerprinted CSS, hermetic assertion suite
default_description: A content site built with Hugo.

verify.name: feed
verify.cmd: test -f public/sitemap.xml && test -f public/index.xml && grep -q '<urlset' public/sitemap.xml && grep -q '<rss' public/index.xml && grep -qF 'Sitemap:' public/robots.txt

verify.name: bad-front-matter-rejected
verify.cmd:
printf '+++
title = 
+++
' > content/zz-bad.md; hugo --quiet --destination .parity/bad >/dev/null 2>&1; status=$?; rm -f content/zz-bad.md; test "$status" -ne 0

verify.name: serve
verify.cmd:
set +e
hugo server --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 18087 --logLevel error > .serve.log 2>&1 &
server=$!
ready=1
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 60 ]; do
  if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18087/ -o .serve-home.html 2>/dev/null; then ready=0; break; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 1
done
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:18087/posts/welcome/)
kill "$server" 2>/dev/null
wait "$server" 2>/dev/null
test "$ready" -eq 0 && test "$code" = 200 && grep -qF 'class="post-list"' .serve-home.html
